```{r setup}
library(phenotwitter)
theme_set(ggthemes::theme_few())
```

# get information flow
```{r, eval = F}
ls_df_group_flow <- tidy_information_flow(ls_df_group_sample = ls_df_group_sample, ls_df_group_valid = ls_df_group_valid, writecsv = T)
usethis::use_data(ls_df_group_flow, overwrite = T)
```

```{r}
bind_rows(ls_df_group_flow) %>%
  distinct(id, from, to) %>%
  inner_join(bind_rows(ls_df_group_user_type) %>% select(user) %>% distinct(), by = c("from" = "user")) %>%
  inner_join(bind_rows(ls_df_group_user_type) %>% select(user) %>% distinct(), by = c("to" = "user")) %>%
  nrow()
```

# code user type
```{r, eval = F}
tidy_user_type(ls_df_group_flow = ls_df_group_flow, df_tweet = df_tweet)
# manually code user type
ls_df_group_user_type <- read_user_type()
usethis::use_data(ls_df_group_user_type)
```

# plot sankey diagram
```{r}
plot_information_flow(ls_df_group_flow = ls_df_group_flow, ls_df_group_user_type = ls_df_group_user_type, save = T)
```

# test difference in proportions
```{r}
test_user_proportion(end = "from")
test_user_proportion(end = "to")
```
